source.citation: V.I. Gridnev, V.G. Khlabutin, E.I. Rozum, S.A. Vorobiev, phys. stat. sol. (b) 140, K13 (1987)
source.method: Visual transcription of the text (p. K14: beam and spot counts N_l) and Table 1 (p. K15: computed W_n(0), Andersen et al. method, 31 plane waves) from the 130 dpi render. Fig. 1 photographs (film FO-5, microphotometer-scanned) are not digitized: film response is nonlinear and no intensity scale is given.

energy_convention: E = gamma m c^2 (total energy), given in steps of 0.50 MeV

beam.divergence_note: Eq. 2 writes the beam profile as exp{-2[(theta - theta0)/Delta theta0]^2}, so Delta theta0 = 0.02 deg is 2 sigma: sigma = 0.01 deg = 0.175 mrad

measured: Number of spots N_l in the exit pattern (text, p. K14). Pairs with equal N_l are reported as practically identical in spot number, intensity and angular spacing.
